extensionDescription.message: Find downloadable media files and supported HLS streams on the current tab.

blockedHelp.message: Media from these domains will not appear in detection results. Add one domain per line.

historyHelp.message: Up to 30 downloads started by FluxFrame, stored only on this device.

privacyNote.message: Detection stays in your browser. Media requests go directly to the source website; recent download names and ignored domains stay in local extension storage.

invalidDomain.message: Enter a domain only, such as example.com.

tooManyDomains.message: You can ignore up to 100 domains.

historyCleared.message: List cleared. Downloaded files were not removed.

keepTabOpen.message: Keep this tab open until the download finishes.

httpDenied.message: The server refused this download. The link may have expired or the site may not make this media available.

networkError.message: The media server connection failed. Check your network and try again.

downloadSent.message: File "__FILE__" (__SIZE__) was sent to your Downloads folder.

separateAudioNote.message: This stream's audio is separate and was saved as "__FILE__". Use a media tool such as FFmpeg to combine them.

tsNote.message: .ts files open in VLC. Use a converter if you need MP4.

noVariants.message: The master playlist has no video variants.

invalidPlaylist.message: The response is not a valid M3U8 playlist.

liveSnapshotNote.message: This appears to be a live stream. Only the portion available now will be downloaded.

invalidMediaUrl.message: The playlist contains an invalid media URL.

unsupportedSessionKey.message: This playlist uses a session encryption key that is not supported.

drmRefusal.message: This stream uses DRM-protected encryption. FluxFrame does not download protected content.

invalidIv.message: The playlist contains an invalid AES-128 IV.

invalidKeyUrl.message: The AES-128 playlist does not provide a valid key URL.

invalidKeySize.message: The AES-128 key has an invalid size.

playlistTooLarge.message: The playlist or segment exceeds the safe memory limit.

downloadLimit.message: The stream exceeds the 300 MB safe in-memory assembly limit.

missingInitSegment.message: The fragmented stream is missing its required initialization segment.

unsupportedPlaylistFeatures.message: This playlist contains features FluxFrame cannot assemble yet.

emptyState.message: No supported media found. Play the video and refresh detection.

privacyFooter.message: Only media available to you is shown.

aboutText.message: FluxFrame finds media files and HLS streams made available by the page. Download only when you have permission. DRM-protected content is not supported.

downloadOpenError.message: The downloader could not be opened. Please try again.

downloadError.message: Chrome could not start this download. Check that the page is still open and try again.

unsupportedPage.message: Detection is unavailable on this Chrome page.

loadError.message: Could not load media from this page.

refreshError.message: Could not refresh. Reload the page and try again.
